# KU Food Hunt
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Keep crawlers out of the transient search/filter permutations.
Disallow: /explore?

# Admin console and the partner submission form. Both already render a noindex
# meta tag; this keeps them out of crawl budget entirely.
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /partners

# The Sitemap directive must be an absolute URL — a relative path is ignored by
# every major crawler. /sitemap.xml itself is generated by the API from the
# published restaurants and served on this origin.
Sitemap: https://kufoodhunt.app/sitemap.xml
